name: Magellan Robust Architecture
desc: This ship has been constructed using typical Magellan engineering principles that prize redundancy and layered protection over high performance.
short: Doubled weapon health and slowed turn rate, increased engine health. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Magellan Ablative Composites
desc: This ship has been constructed with titanic slabs of ablative/absorptive armor composite. While still vulnerable to damage, it's fearsomely resilient.
sModDesc: Increases armor rating by %s and reduces EMP damage taken by %s.
short: Drastically reduces weapon/engine/beam damage taken; limits max armor damage reduction to 70%.

name: Magellan Converted Shuttle Bay
desc: This ship's unusually spacious shuttle bay has been converted to carry fighter LPCs. Thanks to typically overbuilt Magellan systems, there's no degradation of fighter performance.
short: Converts shuttle bay to carry fighter LPCs; increases fighter refit time.

name: Magellan Spacious Hangars
desc: The vast hangars aboard this carrier are well suited for arming and repairing heavy strike craft, although the cavernous spacing within the hull noticeably weakens the ship's superstructure. Squadrons that cost %s or more OP have their cost reduced by %s OP. Increases fighter replacement rate recovery speed by %s. Hangars reduce hull integrity by %s.
short: Discounts heavy fighter wing OP and accelerates refit recovery; reduces hull integrity.

name: Magellan Trajectory Analyzer
desc: An older generation missile targeting computer updated for modern warships. Increases the range of %s composite weapons by %s and conventional missile weapons by %s, but reduces weapon and turret traverse speed by %s.
sModDesc: Negates weapon turn rate penalty and increases Archaic composite weapon range bonus to %s.
short: Boosts Archaic composite and missile weapon ranges; reduces turret traversal speed.

name: Magellan Demilitarized Refit
desc: This ship was constructed by Magellan Fleet shipyards, but has undergone a thorough demilitarization that strips it of any systems deemed too sensitive or dangerous for civilian ownership.
short: Increases weapon and engine health, reduces logistics costs; degrades sensors. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Blackcollar Refit
desc: This ship has been upgraded slightly from the standard design and given a stealth coating for the elite Magellan Blackcollars.
short: Doubled weapon health, increased engine health, reduced sensor profile and recoil, but +30% maintenance. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Skytiger Refit
desc: This ship has been upgraded from the standard design for the elite Magellan Skytiger Guards Division.
short: Doubled weapon health, increased engine health, reduced HE and EMP damage, but -10% top speed. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Herd Refit
desc: This ship has been sloppily refit by the Herd's mechanics, incorporating a number of crude but effective modifications to the engines and other systems. The result is a fast, but clumsy, handling profile, and the internal systems are highly resistant to damage.
short: Doubled weapon health, +10% Armor, flat speed bonus based on hull size, but worse handling and exposed engines. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Tichel Mercantile Refit
desc: This ship has been fitted out to serve in the corporate fleets of the Tichel Mercantile Concern, with an emphasis on speed, defensive operations, and cost-effectiveness.
short: Doubled weapon health, increased speed, reduced DP cost, but -12.5% armor. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Leveller Refit
desc: This ship has been given a comprehensive refit by Leveller mechanics, installing a modern powerplant and shield generator, and improving the ship's handling.
short: Doubled weapon health, +200su energy range, +10% shield efficiency, increased dissipation, but -10% armor. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Leveller Spartacus Reactor
desc: This ship is powered by an experimental cryoflux reactor, which promises improved performance for some critical ship systems.
short: Discounts energy weapon OP, reduces fighter decay, variable EMP damage. Blocks EDC and RFC.

name: Leveller Converted Drone Ship
desc: This ship's cargo hold has been expertly converted into %s built-in drone bays. The conversion process increases deployment cost by %s and reduces cargo capacity by %s units.
short: Adds 6 built-in drone bays; increases DP cost by 75% and reduces cargo by 500 units.

name: Leveller Contra Fighters
desc: Legacy insurgent refit protocol. Obsolete.
short: Legacy insurgent refit protocol (obsolete).

name: Ascendant Spartacus Reactor
desc: This ship serves as the testbed for the experimental Ascendant Spartacus reactor, a highly volatile next-generation Leveller prototype. Despite the delicately-balanced power and flux management systems hindering modularity, this one-off design is incredibly potent.
short: Increases damage, venting rate, and agility; penalizes range, hull, and EMP resistance. Heavy mod restrictions.

name: TMC Assault Frigate Spec
desc: This ship has been modified for a direct-assault role.
short: Increases ballistic rate of fire and projectile speed; reduces weapon flux costs.

name: TMC Beam Frigate Spec
desc: This ship has been modified for a beam-weapon support role.
short: Allows beams to deal hard flux and increases damage against large ships (+20% capitals, +10% cruisers); reduces top speed.

name: TMC Defense Frigate Spec
desc: This ship has been modified for a defensive escort role.
short: Increases weapon damage against fighters and missiles by 50%; PD ignores flares.

name: Herd Converted Carrier
desc: This ship's cargo hold has been haphazardly converted into %s built-in fighter bays. The improvised manufactory that produces fighter chassis is unreliable, and most components have minor defects. Fighter speed reduced by %s, and damage taken increased by %s. The conversion process increases deployment cost by %s and reduces cargo capacity by %s units.
short: Adds 2 built-in fighter bays with defective manufactory; increases DP cost by 50% and reduces cargo by 500 units.

name: Antique Classic Design
desc: This ship is a lovingly preserved classic from an earlier, more cultured era; a combination of careful maintenance and judicious upgrades have kept it competitive in the modern Persean Sector.
short: Increases range by 40%, slows fighter decay by 50%, doubles engine health, grants +1 s-mod. Blocks ITU/DTC and EDC.

name: Antique Restored Classic
desc: This ship is a painstakingly restored classic; a combination of careful reconstruction and replacements with Magellan technology have given it a new lease on life in the modern Persean Sector.
short: Increases weapon range by 30% and doubles engine health. Blocks ITU and DTC.

name: Antique Automated Defender
desc: This ship is an ancient auto-defense unit from the Magellan exile fleet; it has been massively overbuilt, and can operate for centuries with minimal maintenance.
short: Doubles zero-flux speed boost and weapon/engine health. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Early Model Shield
desc: An early model shield generator characteristic of Antique strike craft, featuring primitive flux emitters with dynamic flux-reactive ionization.
short: Antique fighter shield emitter with dynamic flux visual effects.

name: Antique Expeditionary Mothership
desc: The vast internal spaces of this ancient craft conceal many inactive systems and forgotten secrets; an experienced shiphandler will find ways to wring greater performance out of the existing systems, and bring new ones online.
short: Flagship core granting level-scaling speed, crew, bays, and s-mods. Blocks Expanded Deck Crew and Unstable Injector.

name: Magellan Ablative Bulwark
desc: Reinforces the hull and citadel with layered ablative composite tiles and internal spall liners. Increases armor rating by %s and hull integrity by %s, and reduces EMP damage taken by %s, High-Explosive damage by %s, and Fragmentation damage by %s. However, the massive weight reduces combat top speed by %s and interferes with shield projection, increasing shield damage taken by %s.
sModDesc: Increases armor rating by an additional %s, raises maximum armor damage reduction cap by %s, and completely negates top speed and shield damage penalties.
short: Reinforces armor/hull and dampens EMP/HE/frag damage; reduces speed and shield efficiency.

name: Magellan Heavy Strike Catapult
desc: Overhauls flight decks with high-capacity magnetic catapult rails and reinforced recovery cranes. Reduces ordnance point cost of heavy wings (%s OP or higher) by %s, increases replacement rate recovery speed by %s, reduces replacement rate decay on loss by %s, and reduces refit time by %s. However, light wings (under %s OP) suffer a %s penalty and internal conduits reduce hull integrity by %s.
sModDesc: Increases replacement rate recovery speed by an additional %s, improves total refit time reduction to %s, and completely negates light wing OP and hull penalties.
short: Discounts heavy strike wing OP and accelerates refit; penalizes light wings and hull integrity.

name: Magellan High-Torque Grid
desc: Installs high-output hydraulic reaction verniers and calibrated gyro-stabilizers for rapid broadside alignment. Increases weapon and turret traversal speed by %s, ship turn rate by %s, turn acceleration by %s, deceleration by %s, zero-flux speed boost by %s, and combat top speed by %s, while reducing weapon recoil by %s. However, extreme mechanical servo wear reduces peak performance time by %s and increases CR degradation rate by %s.
sModDesc: Increases combat top speed by an additional %s, improves turn acceleration by %s, and completely negates peak performance time and CR degradation penalties.
short: Accelerates turret traverse, turning, and recoil absorption; reduces peak performance time.

name: Magellan Battleline Doctrine
desc: Magellan fleet doctrine emphasizes the primacy of the battleline above all other tactical concerns. Pursuit of a decisive battle with the enemy's fleet is the overarching goal of all operations, and Fleet Ops trains crew and develops new technology around this assumption.
sModDesc: Increases ballistic weapon rate of fire by %s and armor rating by %s.
short: Increases projectile speed, non-beam PD range, and damage to fighters.

name: HULLMOD CONFLICT
desc: %s, the hullmod you tried to install conflicts with this hull or another previously installed hullmod.
short: Blocks incompatible hullmods.

name: Mazian Shuttle Bay
desc: Internal flight bay routing for Mazian-class vessels. Incompatible with standard converted hangar conversions.
short: Incompatible with converted hangar modifications.

name: Magellan Smuggler Upgrades
desc: This ship has been significantly upgraded from the standard spec using a variety of difficult-to-acquire parts from across the sector.
short: Increases weapon/engine health, vent rate, and speed; reduces recoil; +20% maintenance supplies. Blocks Armored Mounts.

name: Magellan Marauder Modifications
desc: This ship has been heavily modified by the Marauders to better control the battlespace with rapid hammer-and-anvil tactics.
short: Increases weapon health, top speed, and nav bonus; reduces fighter decay and turn rate. Blocks Hardened Shields and Armored Mounts.

name: Antique Duncan Testbed
desc: This vessel was most likely modified to be an experimental testbed for military and technological theory of the day. Despite the different design priorities of the overhaul, her underlying construction remains strong and unhindered.
short: Doubles weapon and engine health, halves D-mod effects; reduces weapon turn rate. Blocks Armored Mounts.

name: Antique Anomalous Overdrive
desc: This ship has a non-modular rangekeeper targeting core, closely integrated into the ship's system. When the ship system is engaged, range is boosted considerably, though range suffers afterwards until the system can cool down. Your chief engineer also reports anomalous readings across the ship's subsystems. The full effects are not yet understood, but what is known is that time passes more quickly aboard this vessel when rigged for combat.
short: Targeting core boosting range and speed during system activation; accelerates timeflow. Blocks ITU and DTC.

name: Flight Deck: Bastardsword (BCR)
desc: Reconfigures built-in Jitte bays to manufacture and launch heavy Bastardsword Corvettes. Click (uninstall) to cycle to Lochaber (BCR).
short: Reconfigures built-in bays to Bastardsword Corvettes.

name: Flight Deck: Lochaber (BCR)
desc: Reconfigures built-in Jitte bays to manufacture and launch Lochaber Bombers. Click (uninstall) to cycle to standard Jitte (BCR).
short: Reconfigures built-in bays to Lochaber Bombers.

name: Ancient's Wrath
desc: A wrathful presence inhabits this ship - spiteful of what bound it to this fate, but unable to disobey.
short: Anomalous vessel signature requiring zero crew.

name: Flight Deck: Jitte (BCR)
desc: Configured to manufacture and launch standard Jitte Fighters from built-in bays. Click (uninstall) to cycle to Bastardsword (BCR).
short: Reconfigures built-in bays to standard Jitte Fighters.

name: Magellan Logistics Network
desc: Equips the vessel with automated distribution relays and telemetry links. Increases local cargo and fuel capacity by %s and reduces in-combat repair times by %s, while granting a fleet-wide reduction to monthly supplies and fuel scaling with hull size (stacks up to %s). However, non-combat cargo allocation reduces max CR by %s and increases sensor profile by %s.
sModDesc: Doubles local cargo and fuel capacity bonus to %s, and completely negates maximum combat readiness and sensor profile penalties.
short: Grants local cargo/fuel storage, repair speed, and fleet maintenance discounts; reduces max CR and sensor stealth.
